edits.new:
Then a stub answer with any other error status code is refused by the contract test

  Scenario: AC10 Each business rule BR1 to BR11 of section 8 is named by a criterion and a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR11 of section 8
    When each rule is checked against the contract document and the consuming stories
    Then BR1 holds: the booking body is one element of eight properties with no path, response or error code of its own
    Then BR2 holds: seven facts are required and the booking difference is optional
    Then BR3 holds: nleadsRef maps to nleads_ref and no column is created for the ALS reference
    Then BR4 holds: a booking is confirmed only when ALS and NLEADS both acknowledge, and one acknowledgement holds the case in WITH_OPS_BOOKING
    Then BR5 holds: firstDueDate starts durable timers inside TreatmentWorkflow and no timer row, clock table or Schedule is created
    Then BR6 holds: the cadence, the due-date rule and the callback limit are values in force with their version and no code constant
    Then BR7 holds: the booking facts are read from the v_ace views and copied nowhere
    Then BR8 holds: a refused body names its field with MSG-GEN-001 before any write, and a record failure with MSG-P7-003 makes the apply step roll back
    Then BR9 holds: the schedule view is checked for capability area Treatment and offer with right R, and a correction for right U
    Then BR10 holds: a published version is never edited, and a breaking change raises major version 2
    Then BR11 holds: the body carries facts and identifiers only, with no customer, account, document or personal value
